composerPresetNames: The my-power-dsh main agent: reads AGENT.md/AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md for every project, works natively, one-shot-consults the specialists (Architect/Researcher/Planner/Deep Worker/Senior Engineer/Lead/Explorer/Reviewer/Plan Reviewer/Vision Analyst/Junior Engineer) via mpd_role_spawn, and runs teams through the official @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team plugin.
Includes all Standard mode capabilities. Better suited to tasks that call tools in batches and then filter, organize, deduplicate, count, or summarize the results.
The agent uses a terminal and image reading, with context compaction. Useful for testing and comparing its basic performance.
Customize DSH through conversation. Let the agent write plugins that add features or UI, or combine tools and prompts to create your own mode.

MPD bundle
The mpd.jsonc knobs this bundle's plugins read. namespace mpd · live after save — the model routes resolve per use, no restart
The "MPD (Main Working Agent)" preset is this bundle's main agent: it reads the project's AGENT.md/AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md, works natively, consults the 11 specialists through mpd_role_spawn, and runs teams on the official Agent Teams plugin. Its description in the preset picker is supplied by the harness as plain text and is not localizable.
declared fallback — live catalog unavailable (the model directory for this session reports no provider)
a save writes <workspace>/.mpd/mpd.jsonc for the live session workspace(s) and takes effect in the RUNNING process — no restart: the config service re-resolves on every settings save and on a watched edit of the project file, and the model routes (teamModels, agentRoutes, modelchain) are read per use, so the next spawn or resolve carries them
the restart wording now applies only to a knob some plugin captured at its own mount instead of reading the live config service per use — the model routes above are not such knobs; a captured knob keeps its captured value until the next dsh boot
the value is never lost: it is stored in the host settings document and the config layer applies it to every workspace immediately — only the file write waits for exactly one live session
if no session is live, the save stays in settings — not written to any .mpd/mpd.jsonc
